title: Nomba Virtual Account
description: Schema representing a Nomba virtual bank account used for collecting payments via bank transfers.

accountRef.description: The unique reference identifier for the virtual account.

accountName.description: The name associated with the virtual account, typically the customer name.

accountNumber.description: The bank account number assigned to the virtual account.

bankName.description: The name of the bank providing the virtual account number.

bankCode.description: The bank code of the issuing bank.

status.description: The current status of the virtual account.

expiryDate.description: The date and time the virtual account expires and stops accepting payments.

createdAt.description: The date and time the virtual account was created.

updatedAt.description: The date and time the virtual account was last updated.
